questions.questionText: Two cars start from points 360 km apart. Travelling towards each other they meet in 4 hours; travelling in the same direction (the faster chasing the slower) the faster overtakes the slower in 18 hours. What is the speed of the faster car?
questions.explanation: Sum of speeds = 360/4 = 90. Difference = 360/18 = 20. Faster = (90 + 20)/2 = 55 km/h.
questions.shortcut: Opposite directions give the sum, same direction gives the difference; then (sum + difference)/2 is the larger speed.
